# mv: func-to-method with unnamed first parameter
mv F T.M
-- x.go --
package p

type T struct{}

func F(T) int { return 0 }

func f() {
	var t T
	_ = F(t)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,9 +2,9 @@

 type T struct{}

-func F(T) int { return 0 }
+func (T) M() int { return 0 }

 func f() {
 	var t T
-	_ = F(t)
+	_ = t.M()
 }
